headline: Premier League Saturday: Chelsea host Spurs at Stamford Bridge
whyCareReason: Spurs arrive buoyed by their 3-1 win over Coventry. Chelsea sit fourth on 13 points.
teaser: Saturday 24 October, 17:30 UK, Stamford Bridge. City lead table on 21; Arsenal have 18.
story: Matchweek 8 features a London derby on Saturday, 24 October, at Stamford Bridge. Tottenham Hotspur visit Chelsea at 17:30 UK. Spurs enter fresh off their first league win of the season, a 3-1 comeback over Coventry City that lifted them to 16th on 6 points. Chelsea sit fourth on 13 points (4-1-2). Manchester City lead the Premier League on 21 points with a perfect seven wins from seven, three clear of Arsenal on 18 points. No score is posted for Saturday.
stakes: Spurs look to build momentum out of the relegation zone while Chelsea aim to keep pace with the top three.
rivalryAngle: Fierce London rivals meet at Stamford Bridge five days after Spurs climbed off the bottom.
funFacts: Saturday 24 October, 17:30 UK, Stamford Bridge, Sky Sports. Status upcoming.
Table: City 21 (7-0-0), Arsenal 18, Brighton 16, Chelsea 13, Liverpool 12.
